subject: CS243
filterSummary: Selected 5 English and 4 Arabic videos covering key topics in recurrence relations. Coverage is strong in English, with high-quality, popular videos for all topics. Arabic coverage is good for most topics, but no suitable video was found for handling repeated roots, as candidates were about differential equations.

coverage.note: Only one candidate passed the view count gate.
Most other candidates were about differential equations, not recurrence relations.
